# Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)

> Rapar Rubel is the online name of Rubel Miah, also known as Rubel Public: an independent AI expert and AI workflow builder in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He builds AI agents, automation and AI-powered products that work in Bangla, Banglish and English, and pairs them with business strategy, content and brand psychology (reading what an audience says, fears and shares).

Full text of the profile and every blog post: https://rubelpublic.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Content approach
1. Listen: collect the exact words the audience uses (comments, inbox, reviews, searches)
2. Decode: find the need, fear and hope under the request
3. Frame: one angle, one emotion; the brand as the answer to a need
4. Create: native content in Bangla, Banglish or English for each platform
5. Test & systemise: keep what drives saves, shares, replies and sales; make it repeatable

## Services
- Content strategy, audience research and brand psychology; Banglish/Bangla copy, product photography and social creative
- Business strategy: business models, pricing, offers, funnels, operating plans
- AI: agents, prompt systems, workflow automation, team training in Bangla and English
- Product: websites, web apps and internal tools from brief to launch
- Creative: brand systems, campaigns, social creative, AI video direction
- Operations: hands-on coordination across technology, retail, property and marketing

## Work
- Paloan: Rapar Rubel's personal AI agent for audience research, content drafts, planning and workflows
- CAP ON HEAD: content, product photography and product presentation on social media and the website for a Bangladesh cap brand (https://caponhead.com/)
- Myook: social media and website for a clothing brand, product-led creatives and ad concepts (https://www.facebook.com/myookclothing)
- MimAI: AI file assistant for the user's own Google Drive; understands Bangla, Banglish and English (https://mimai.onrender.com)
- Proyojon Abashon: land share and property management platform in Dhaka (https://www.proyojonabashon.com)
- Proyojon Prozukti: technology, digital marketing, creative and business-solutions brand
- Proyojon Solutions: online-first legal and business advisory with AI-assisted intake
- Proyojon Shop / Proyojon 360: retail and import of toys, stationery, bags and accessories; online store at https://www.proyojon.shop
- The AB Wardrobe: women's kurti and two-piece label
- Proyojon Vromon: travel brand and website for hotels, tickets and travel stories (https://proyojonvromon.com/)
- Gaan Banai — MusicDirector: creative-AI music workflow concept
- AI Power User: practical AI course taught in Bangla (10 classes, 18–20 hours, 70% hands-on)
